issue_context.title: Inaccurate log for when a volume is bound to a claim
issue_context.body:
### What happened?

This line reads as if the bound has already happened:

https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/blob/3702411ef9d99e2fe186381474692fdb970a3b4c/pkg/scheduler/framework/plugins/volumebinding/binder.go#L578

But, if I read correctly, the bound happens immediately after:

https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/blob/3702411ef9d99e2fe186381474692fdb970a3b4c/pkg/scheduler/framework/plugins/volumebinding/binder.go#L579

And there is even a wait for confirmation after:

https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/blob/3702411ef9d99e2fe186381474692fdb970a3b4c/pkg/scheduler/framework/plugins/volumebinding/binder.go#L526-L529

### What did you expect to happen?

The log line to better describe the actual state and another log line at V(2) to confirm that the operation ended.

review_comments: Is this just a V(4) because the error is logged higher in the call stack as well?
Should I increase the verbosity to V(2) ?
Can you verify what happens with the returned error?

According to the code, if an error occurs it will be returned to retry scheduling. It goes back to `handleBindingCycleError` in schedule_one.go.

https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/blob/master/pkg/scheduler/framework/plugins/volumebinding/volume_binding.go#L322-L349

Right, so ultimately it would be logged here https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/blob/a5f59ccf37fabacf0339aeaf95b6929db7460f64/pkg/scheduler/schedule_one.go#L884

No need to increase the verbosity in this line.
understood, I'll leave the PR as it is and wait for additional review/approval
